messages:
ana: Heads-up: new quant canary showing structured output truncation when streaming + continuous-batch + kvcache enabled. Rate ~0.7% in last hour.

leo: Saw a sample where `scores` array ends mid-number: e.g. `...,0.78,0.9` then EOF. client JSONDecodeError.

maya: We rolled int4 kernels and increased stream-chunk timeout yesterday. Any kernel-side flush changes?

ana: No other prompt/schema changes. Local quick reproducer: int4 + batch + cache = ~1.0% truncation, disable batching => 0.03%.

ci-bot: quick-scan (2k calls): trunc_rate=0.72% (stream=true, batch=continuous, kvcache=on). stream=false -> 0.05%.

leo: Hypothesis: emission pacing on quant kernels leaves final token in queue when stream flush occurs. Could be tokenizer producing a multi-byte token boundary.

maya: Mitigations: 1) SDK soft-healer: append closing brackets/quotes when trailing fragment detected and mark healer_applied. 2) Mirror to fp16 fallback and compare. 3) Add console metric `truncated_structured_field_rate`.

ana: I'll draft the SDK healer PR limited to hosted dev routes and ensure healed outputs flagged. Also kicking off ablation: int4/int8/fp16 x batching on/off x streaming on/off.

runtime-bot: Job `quant-stream-ablation` created. Will add token-emission tracing for int4 kernels overnight.

leo: Short term: if production 5m sliding >0.5% we should rollback quant on canary.

ana: Agreed. Posting ablation results & PR link when ready.
